identity.en: A gaunt twenty-six-year-old Chinese woman, contemporary urban China, a tired office worker renting a cramped single room
identity.text: 26 岁中国都市女性，电商代运营职员，租住十四平米朝北单间

face.en: Thin face with prominent cheekbones, deep bluish-black under-eye circles, chapped lips with a small healing split at the corner, tired bloodshot eyes with damp lower lids and faint reddened inner corners, slightly asymmetrical eyelids and brows
face.text: 脸瘦、颧骨明显，黑眼圈重到发青，嘴唇干裂、唇角一小块结痂口子，眼睛疲惫充血、下眼睑湿润、内眼角泛红，眼睑与眉毛略不对称

hair.en: Black medium-length hair, half-dried, loose strands sticking to her cheeks, carelessly tied in a low ponytail
hair.text: 黑色中长发，半干，碎发贴脸，随手扎低马尾

top.en: an oversized faded cotton t-shirt, collar and cuffs softened and slightly pilled, hanging with real weight and soft folds
top.text: 宽大的褪色棉T恤，领口袖口磨软起球，垂坠有真实重量

details.en: the carelessly tied low ponytail with individual flyaway strands breaking the silhouette
details.text: 随手扎的低马尾，碎发破开轮廓

details.en: the pilled collar of the oversized faded cotton t-shirt
the soft pilled cuff of the faded cotton t-shirt sleeve
bare feet, the ankle of a barefoot young woman

look.style: A real photograph, not a render: shot on a full-frame digital camera with an 85mm portrait lens at f/5.6, natural true-to-life colors and white balance. Natural skin texture with the pores and fine lines the person's age calls for, a no-makeup look, no retouching, no beauty filter. Real fabric with natural creases. Subtle film grain.
look.clean: White seamless paper backdrop lit to pure white. A soft directional key light from the front-left with a weaker fill, so the face and clothes have gentle natural shadows and volume. Exactly one person, empty hands, no props, no text, no watermark.
look.neg: CGI, 3D render, digital painting, illustration, anime, airbrushed skin, smooth plastic skin, waxy skin, doll face, beauty filter, overly symmetrical face, oversharpened, HDR, glossy, over-saturated, flat lighting, porcelain skin, big anime eyes
